svg.title: simulate — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, a model that cannot execute, an invalid design or an overflowing emission mean fails the call. Otherwise one batch of histories is generated and checked, and failed checks are saved as warnings. Repeated applied calls return their full result; running duplicates return progress. Authored laws use the optional named panel for calendar binding. With interventions, a causal effect is reported only when the effect is identified and the fit behind the model is certified and converged; otherwise the histories are saved with the reason.
